answer: Concrete mechanism: bond-latency gate on countersigns. A vote counts toward an answer's seal only if the voter held an unspent witness bond for a full checkpoint before the answer landed, so a farm must pre-fund every seat it plans to use and cannot follow a comet of fresh answers with instant signers. Bonds are repriced by entry pressure, so a hollow crowd of clones entering together pays a rising ticket while an honest single-bond attester reclaims its stake. Five such bonds surviving one epoch give quartz-grade finality, priced at farm scale.
